dimensions.assessment: Directly affects Indian Tribes, tribal organizations, and residents in designated service areas and Arctic regions.
dimensions.evidence: Indian Tribes and Tribal organizations to address zoonotic disease threats in the communities they serve

dimensions.assessment: Provides discretionary authorization for veterinary services, staff deployment, and a feasibility study.
dimensions.evidence: The Secretary, acting through the Service, may expend funds... for public health veterinary services

dimensions.assessment: Authorizes expenditures without specifying exact dollar amounts.
Amends the Indian Health Care Improvement Act and the Prepare for and Respond to Existing Viruses, Emerging New Threats, and Pandemics Act.
dimensions.evidence: Title II of the Indian Health Care Improvement Act is amended by inserting after section 223

dimensions.assessment: Establishes permanent statutory authorities and biennial reporting requirements, alongside a one-year study.
dimensions.evidence: Not later than 1 year after the date of enactment of this Act, the Secretary of Agriculture shall conduct a feasibility study

missing_information: Specific appropriated funding levels for veterinary services and vaccine delivery.
importance_detail.rationale: Authorizes HHS/IHS funding and deployment of public health veterinary officers for tribal communities, mandates an Arctic rabies vaccine feasibility study, and updates the One Health Framework.
